BiblicalUsage: euschēmosýnē means comeliness. In 1 Corinthians 12:23, the text says "and our uncomely [parts] have more abundant comeliness."
TheologicalSignificance: In euschēmosýnē I find no hidden theology; it simply means comeliness.
